fields.schemeName: Annai Teresa Ninaivu Marriage Assistance Scheme for Orphan Girls-I
fields.briefDescription: "Annai Teresa Ninaivu Marriage Assistance Scheme for Orphan Girls-I" was launched by the Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Dept, Govt of Tamil Nadu. The scheme provides financial assistance to the orphan girls for their marriage. The bride should be 18 years or older during her marriage.

fields.schemeName: Disablement Benefit Scheme (PBAOCWWB)
fields.briefDescription: Through this scheme, financial assistance of ₹75,000/- is extended based on the Disablement Certificate issued by the Competent Authority to the Registered Construction Worker of the Board. The amount is credited through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into the bank account of the worker.

fields.schemeName: Refund of Contribution Scheme (PBAOCWWB)
fields.briefDescription: The "Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board" repays the amount of contribution paid by the deceased beneficiary to the nominee of the deceased member. The amount is credited within 7 days through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into the bank account of the nominee.

fields.schemeName: Dr. Dharmambal Ammaiyar Ninaivu  Widow Remarriage Assistance Scheme-I
fields.briefDescription: The "Dr. Dharmambal Ammaiyar Ninaivu Widow Remarriage Assistance Scheme" was launched by the Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme's objective is to encourage widow remarriage and to rehabilitate widows by giving financial assistance.

fields.schemeName: Scheme of Free Supply of Textbooks, Stationery, Uniforms and Footwears to Poor Children
fields.briefDescription: Through this scheme, textbooks, notebooks, Uniforms, dictionaries, stationery, etc. are provided free of cost to all students studying in LKG to 12th Standard of all Government and Government-aided Private Schools. The objective of this scheme is to achieve 100% student enrolment.

fields.schemeName: Deepawali Cash Gift Scheme (PULWS)
fields.briefDescription: The Puducherry Unorganised Labourers' Welfare Society extends ₹500/- to the Unorganised Workers as a Cash Gift during the festival of Diwali. The amount is credited through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into the bank account of the worker. The applications are accepted offline.

fields.schemeName: Pension Scheme for Destitute Transgender
fields.briefDescription: The 'Pension Scheme for Destitute Transgender' was launched by the Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to help poor transgender above 40 years of age who are unable to earn their livelihood.

fields.schemeName: Scheme for Giving Awards to Traditional Artists
fields.briefDescription: Through the "Scheme for Giving Awards to Traditional Artists", awards are conferred to the participant artists whose works are adjudged outstanding among the entries at the State-level Traditional Art Exhibition conducted by the Kuzhu. The awarded works are put on display for public view.

fields.schemeName: Scheme of Giving Awards to Eminent Artists - Kalai Nanmani Award
fields.briefDescription: "Scheme of Giving Awards to Eminent Artists - Kalai Nanmani Award" by the Art and Culture Department, Government of Tamil Nadu aims to promote and preserve the culture of Tamil Nadu. The selected artists are awarded financial assistance ₹15,000/- and certificates of appreciation.

fields.schemeName: Scheme to Award Scholarship to Young Artists
fields.briefDescription: The "Scheme to Award Scholarship to Young Artists" was launched by the Art and Culture Department, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to encourage the postgraduate and graduate students of the Government College of Fine Arts, Chennai & Kumbakonam by awarding scholarships every year.

fields.schemeName: Shramyogi Home Town Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to facilitate the payment of railway fares for migrant labourers employed in the organized sector in Gujarat, enabling them to travel to or from their home country to the nearest railway station.

fields.schemeName: Educational Award Scheme - Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
fields.briefDescription: The scheme has been implemented by the Gujarat Labour Welfare Board to encourage the children (students) of the Labours to increase their enthusiasm and to get higher education through it.

fields.schemeName: Marriage Assistance Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
fields.briefDescription: Under the scheme, financial assistance is provided to female workers who are working in a factory/organization in the state of Gujarat after their marriage.

fields.schemeName: Plastic Tunnel (Lo-Tunnel)
fields.briefDescription: Plastic tunnels (low tunnels) provide benefits to farmers. These are protected structures created by covering each crop bed with a low-lying plastic sheet after the crops have been planted in the main field.

fields.schemeName: Private Tuition Assistance to Scheduled Caste Students Studying in Standard 11th & 12th (Science Stream)
fields.briefDescription: Under the scheme, financial assistance is provided to Scheduled Caste (SC) students who are studying in Standard 11th and 12th (Science Stream) and have obtained 70% or more marks in the 10th Standard for private coaching.

fields.schemeName: Food Bill Assistance to SC Students
fields.briefDescription: The food bill assistance at the rate of ₹1,500/- per month (Up to 10 Months) will be granted to the Scheduled Caste (SC) students admitted in college-affiliated hostels.

fields.schemeName: Festival Gift Coupons (Sainik Welfare)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Festival Gift Coupons" is a Welfare Scheme by the Armed Forces Flag Day Fund of the Department of Sainik Welfare, Puducherry. The objective of the scheme is to provide Festival Gift Coupons worth ₹4,000/- per annum to the Non-Pensioner ESMs who are 60 years or older in age.

fields.schemeName: Dr. Baba Saheb Ambedkar Loan for Higher Study in Foreign Countries
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, a loan of ₹15 lakhs is provided at an interest rate of 4% to offer financial assistance to bright career students of the Scheduled Castes who cannot go abroad for higher studies due to the their poor economic condition.

fields.schemeName: Special Scholarship to Students Belonging to the Most Backward Castes among Scheduled Castes (Vandaniya Sant Shri Vasiyadada Scholarship)
fields.briefDescription: This scheme offers special scholarships to students from the Most Backward Castes among the Scheduled Castes category who are enrolled in Standards I to X.

fields.schemeName: Home Loan Interest Subsidy Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
fields.briefDescription: Under the scheme, a 3% Interest Subsidy is provided to workers who are employed in the organized sector to buy their own house and get relief from interest deductions on loans taken from banks.

fields.schemeName: Old Age Pension - Chandigarh
fields.briefDescription: The Old Age Pension scheme aims to provide financial assistance and support to elderly citizens who have reached a certain age and require regular income for their sustenance.

fields.schemeName: Free Cycles to SC Girl Students Studying in Standard IX (Sarasvati Sadhna Yojana)
fields.briefDescription: The “Free Cycles to SC girl students studying in Standard IX” scheme is administered by the Directorate of Scheduled Caste Welfare, Department of Social Justice & Empowerment, Government of Gujarat. Under this scheme, free bicycles are given to scheduled caste girl students who are studying in Stand

fields.schemeName: One Time Cash Incentive towards Completing ITI, Typewriting, Accountancy, Bookkeeping, Tailoring, Computer Training (Sainik Welfare)
fields.briefDescription: "One Time Cash Incentive towards Completing ITI, Typewriting, Accountancy, Bookkeeping, Tailoring, Computer Training" by the Dept of Sainik Welfare, Puducherry, provides upto ₹10,000/- to the unemployed Ex-servicemen / Widow/Dependent of the ESM to pursue the mentioned programs/courses.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance to SC Students Studying in Medical, Engineering and Diploma Course for Purchasing Educational Instrument
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme ₹10,000/- for Medical students, ₹8,000/- for Engineering students and ₹3,000/- Diploma students granted for purchase of study instrument to the Scheduled Caste students studying in Medical, Engineering, Diploma courses.

fields.schemeName: Scheme of Extending Financial Assistance to New Drama Productions
fields.briefDescription: "Scheme of Extending Financial Assistance to New Drama Productions" aims to encourage the dance-drama art forms and the artists involved in such arts. The scheme provides grants of ₹20,000/- for the production and staging of new Tamil dance dramas based on Tamil arts, literature and culture.

fields.schemeName: Jal Hauj
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the Jal Hauj scheme is to promote sustainable water management practices and address water scarcity issues by facilitating the construction of water harvesting structures.

fields.schemeName: Marriage Assistance to Normal Persons Marrying Speech and Hearing Impaired Persons
fields.briefDescription: The scheme 'Marriage Assistance to Normal Persons Marrying Speech and Hearing Impaired Persons' was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to differently-abled couple.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Marriage (GBOCWWB)
fields.briefDescription: "Financial Assistance for Marriage (GBOCWWB)" by the Goa Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of the Dept of Labour and Employment, Goa, provides financial assistance of ₹4,000/- for the marriage of the children of the worker who has a continuous membership for 3 years with the Boar

fields.schemeName: Dr. Savitaben Ambedkar Inter Caste Marriage Assistance Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme has been implemented as part of social empowerment by addressing inequality through marriages between individuals from Scheduled Castes of Hinduism and those from castes other than Scheduled Castes of Hinduism.

fields.schemeName: Fodder Minikits under Tribal Area Sub Plan (TASP) Scheme (ST Category)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Fodder Minikits under Tribal Area Sub Plan (TASP) Scheme” is implemented by the Directorate of Animal Husbandry, Government of Gujarat to provide an improved variety of fodder seeds to Scheduled Tribe beneficiaries for widespread publicity, demonstration, and adaptation by farmers.

fields.schemeName: Aaws Bhatta Sahayata Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The Aaws Bhatta Sahaayata Yojana Government of Madhya Pradesh runs this scheme for those poor students belonging to Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe of its state whose college is very far from their house and they have to rent accommodation near the college to study.

fields.schemeName: Chetan Chauhan Labor Sports Promotion Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The Chetan Chauhan Shramik Krida Protsahan Yojana (CCSKPY) is a scheme launched by the Uttar Pradesh government in 2022 to provide financial assistance to the children of construction workers for participating in sports

fields.schemeName: Dr. P. G. Solanki Scheme for Loan/Assistance to Medical Post Graduate Doctors of Scheduled Caste
fields.briefDescription: Under the scheme, loans/financial assistance is given to the Scheduled Caste Medical Post Graduate (M.D/M.S) Doctors to start their independent profession, clinic consultation room, etc.

fields.schemeName: Medical Assistance (GBOCWWB)
fields.briefDescription: Through the "Medical Assistance (GBOCWWB)" scheme, the worker who is hospitalized for 5 or more days due to an accident or any disease is provided with ₹400/- for the first 5 days and ₹40/- for the remaining days, subject to a maximum ₹2,000/-.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance on the Natural Death of Differently Abled Person
fields.briefDescription: "Financial Assistance on the Natural Death of Differently Abled Person" was launched by the Dept for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Tamil Nadu. A financial assistance of ₹15,000/- is provided to the legal heir in the event of the natural death of the differently-abled person.

fields.schemeName: Tricycles - Tamil Nadu
fields.briefDescription: The Department launched the 'Tricycles by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons' scheme for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Govt. of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to distribute tricycles to deserving orthopedically differently abled persons affected by both lower limbs for their easy mobility

fields.schemeName: Establishing Aavin Parlour for Differently Abled Persons
fields.briefDescription: The 'Establishing Aavin Parlour for Differently Abled Persons' scheme was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Govt. of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to create self-employment avenues for differently abled persons, the govt. has issued orders to establish Parlour.

fields.schemeName: Behind the Ear Hearing Aids by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons
fields.briefDescription: 'Behind the Ear Hearing Aids by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons' scheme was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to encourage hearing-impaired students to wear hearing aids to increase their speech capacity.

fields.schemeName: Dr. Ambedkar Awas Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Under the scheme, financial assistance of ₹1,20,000/- is provided to Scheduled Caste individuals who do not own a residential home, have an old rough residential home, or own a plot for residence, and who belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category for the construction of a house.

fields.schemeName: Disable Marriage Scheme (Divyang Lagna Sahay)
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to persons with disabilities when a person with a disability marries another person with a disability, as well as when a non-disabled person marries someone with a disability.

fields.schemeName: Post Metric Scholarship - Madhya Pradesh
fields.briefDescription: Under the Post-Matric Scholarship is a Madhya Pradesh Government initiative to provide financial assistance to economically weaker social class students to pursue higher education after matriculation.

fields.schemeName: Sewing Machine Scheme (HBOCWWB)
fields.briefDescription: This scheme aims to encourage registered women construction workers and to enable them to mend their clothing at their homes. Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to registered women construction workers to purchase a Sewing Machine.

fields.schemeName: West Bengal Artisans Financial Benefit Scheme 2024: Grant to Individual Artisans
fields.briefDescription: “Grant to Individual Artisans” is a sub-scheme under "West Bengal Artisans Financial Benefit Scheme 2024”, by the MSME and Textiles Dept, Government of West Bengal, aims to create, support and sustain an enabling ecosystem for strengthening creativity and capacity of the artisans.

fields.schemeName: West Bengal Handloom and Khadi Weavers Financial Benefit Scheme 2024: Assistance to Individual Handloom Weaver
fields.briefDescription: “Assistance to Individual Handloom Weaver" is a sub-scheme under "West Bengal Handloom and Khadi Weavers Financial Benefit Scheme 2024”, implemented by the MSME and Textiles Dept, Government of West Bengal aims to  provide one-time financial assistance to the individual Handloom weavers.

fields.schemeName: Incentive for Purchase of Electric Scooter for the Daughter of a Registered Construction Worker (HBOCWWB)
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, an incentive of ₹50,000/- or the actual ex-showroom price of electric scooter, whichever is lower, will be provided by the Board through e-RUPI to the daughter of a registered construction worker to facilitate her mobility while pursuing higher education.

fields.schemeName: Destitute Agricultural Labourers Pension Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The "Destitute Agricultural Labourers Pension Scheme" was launched by the Social Welfare and Nutritious Meal Programme Department, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to give pensions of ₹1,000/- to destitute agricultural labourers of 60 years and above and dhoti, saree supplied on festivals.

fields.schemeName: Sathya Ammaiyar Ninaivu Government Children Homes
fields.briefDescription: The "Sathya Ammaiyar Ninaivu Government Children Homes" was launched by the Social Welfare and Nutritious Meal Programme Department, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide education to destitute, deserted and abandoned children by giving free food, clothing, shelter and medical care.

fields.schemeName: Braille Watches by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Department
fields.briefDescription: The 'Braille Watches by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Department' scheme was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Government of Tamil Nadu. Under this scheme, braille watches are distributed to working visually impaired persons.

fields.schemeName: Mukhya Mantri Samajik Suraksha Yojana: Death & Funeral Assistance (HBOCWWB)
fields.briefDescription: Under the scheme, the Haryana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board provides financial assistance of ₹5 lakhs to the nominee or legal heir in the event of a registered worker's death due to an accident at the workplace. Additionally, ₹15,000/- will be provided for funeral expenses.

fields.schemeName: Magnifiers - Tamil Nadu
fields.briefDescription: The Department launched the "Magnifiers by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Department" scheme for differently-abled persons. Under this scheme, magnifiers are distributed to needy students with low vision to enable them to read books.
